metadata.overview: Controls MicroBT Whatsminer Bitcoin miners through API v2 on port 4028 or API v3 on port 4433. Compatibility is determined by firmware API capabilities rather than a hard-coded model allowlist. Operations affect physical hardware — prioritize thermal safety.

telemetry.name: hashrate_rt
telemetry.description: Real-time hashrate.

telemetry.name: hashrate_avg
telemetry.description: Average hashrate.

telemetry.name: power
telemetry.description: Current power draw.

telemetry.name: temperature
telemetry.description: Chip temperature.

telemetry.name: fan_speed_in
telemetry.description: Inlet fan speed.

telemetry.name: fan_speed_out
telemetry.description: Outlet fan speed.

telemetry.name: status
telemetry.description: Device status.

telemetry.name: uptime
telemetry.description: Seconds since last boot.

telemetry.name: accepted_shares
telemetry.description: Total accepted shares. API v3 on port 4433 does not expose share counts, so this channel returns 0 for that protocol.

telemetry.name: rejected_shares
telemetry.description: Total rejected shares. API v3 on port 4433 does not expose share counts, so this channel returns 0 for that protocol.

telemetry.name: pool_url
telemetry.description: Active pool URL.

telemetry.name: efficiency
telemetry.description: Power efficiency.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Current power mode.

telemetry.name: api_version
telemetry.description: Detected WhatsMiner API generation/version used for this connection (API v2 on port 4028 or API v3 on port 4433).

telemetry.name: firmware_info
telemetry.description: Normalized control-board, platform, firmware and API version information.

telemetry.name: device_info
telemetry.description: Normalized miner identity and network information. Pool passwords and API credentials are never included.

telemetry.name: psu_info
telemetry.description: Normalized power-supply identity, firmware, fan speed and electrical input information when exposed by the firmware.

telemetry.name: miner_stats
telemetry.description: Normalized mining performance, power, temperature, fan and tuning statistics. Values are cached briefly by the device client to avoid duplicate device requests.

telemetry.name: hashboards
telemetry.description: Per-hashboard slot, hashrate, frequency, effective-chip and chip-temperature data.

telemetry.name: pools
telemetry.description: Configured pool endpoints and runtime status. Worker passwords are never included; API v3 firmware may omit share counters.

telemetry.name: errors
telemetry.description: Active device error codes with normalized names and messages. An empty array means that no active error was reported.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Full structured snapshot (stats + config), same shape the legacy metrics pull returned.

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Restarts the miner controller. Takes 2-3 minutes to resume.
commands.constraints: Do not call more than once per 5 minutes.

commands.name: setPowerMode
commands.constraints: Supported modes and their physical limits depend on miner firmware and cooling configuration. Do not select a higher-power mode unless cooling is operational.

commands.name: setupPools
commands.description: Configure mining pools. Uses the worker's configured pools when none are passed.
commands.constraints: Changes active mining destinations. Preserve the previous pool configuration before applying. A timeout has an unknown physical outcome and must not be retried automatically.

commands.name: setPowerPct
commands.constraints: Values above 100 percent are accepted only by supported hydro or immersion miners. Air-cooled miners are limited to 100 percent. Verify cooling before increasing power.

commands.name: downloadLogs
commands.description: Package and download the miner diagnostic logs as a Base64-encoded .tgz archive with size and SHA-256 metadata.
commands.constraints: Log archives may be large. Store or decode the returned data promptly and avoid concurrent downloads from the same miner.

commands.name: setNetwork
commands.description: Configure DHCP or a static IPv4 address. Pass network.dhcp=true for DHCP, or network.dhcp=false with ip, netmask, gateway and dns fields for static addressing.
commands.constraints: The miner reboots and the current connection drops after this command. Preserve the old address and verify reachability at the new address. A timeout or connection reset has an unknown physical outcome and must not be retried automatically.

commands.name: setHostname
commands.description: Set the miner controller hostname. The configured name becomes fully effective after a controller restart.
commands.constraints: Use a valid 1-63 character hostname containing only letters, digits and internal hyphens.

commands.name: updateFirmware
commands.description: Verify a Base64-encoded firmware image, select the payload matching the miner control-board platform and upload the raw bytes directly to the miner.
commands.constraints: Firmware updates reboot the controller and can render the miner unreachable. The firmware object must include filename, encoding=base64, size, sha256 and data and must not exceed 64 MiB. The upload is sent once and is never retried; a timeout or disconnect after transmission has an unknown physical outcome.

troubleshooting: If alert.overheat, verify fan speeds. Fan speed of 0 is a mechanical failure.
If alert.hashrate_low, miner may be tuning boards — wait 15 minutes.
If status is OFFLINE, do not attempt reboot. Escalate to operator.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_CONFIG_INVALID: The device address or API password is missing.
errors.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION: The requested WhatsMiner API version is not supported.
errors.ERR_API_VERSION_REQUIRED_FOR_CUSTOM_PORT: A custom port with probing disabled requires an explicit API version.
errors.ERR_AUTH_FAILED: The API v3 device rejected authentication.
errors.ERR_TOKEN_FETCH_IP_LIMIT: The miner rejected the salt or token request because the API client limit or permission policy was reached.
errors.ERR_INVALID_AUTH_RESPONSE: The API v3 salt response was successful but did not contain a usable salt.
errors.ERR_API_RESPONSE_INVALID: The device returned an invalid API response.
errors.ERR_API_V3_FRAME_LENGTH_INVALID: The API v3 length-prefixed response frame is invalid.
errors.ERR_API_V3_FRAME_INCOMPLETE: The API v3 TCP connection ended before the declared response frame was complete.
errors.ERR_API_V3_TIMEOUT: The API v3 request did not receive a complete response before its deadline. For writes, the physical outcome is unknown and the command must not be retried automatically.
errors.ERR_API_V3_CONNECTION: The API v3 TCP connection failed or was reset. For writes, the physical outcome may be unknown and the command must not be retried automatically.
errors.ERR_FAIL: The API v3 firmware returned its generic failure code.
errors.ERR_INVALID_CMD: The installed firmware does not expose the requested command.
errors.ERR_JSON_CMD: The API v2 firmware rejected the command JSON.
errors.ERR_PERMISSION_DENIED: The API v2 firmware rejected the authenticated command.
errors.ERR_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The API v2 authentication token expired.
errors.ERR_IP_LIMIT: The API v2 firmware rejected the request because the API client limit was reached.
errors.ERR_NO_PERMISSION: The API v3 firmware rejected the authenticated command.
errors.ERR_UNKNOWN_API_CODE: The API v3 firmware returned an unrecognized response code.
errors.ERR_MINER_STATS_FAILED: The miner statistics response was missing or invalid.
errors.ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE: A command parameter has an invalid type.
errors.ERR_INVALID_MODE: The requested power mode is not supported.
errors.ERR_SET_LED_ENABLED_INVALID: The LED enabled parameter must be boolean.
errors.ERR_SET_POWER_MODE_INVALID: The requested power mode is not valid for a write action.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_FAILED: The device command failed without a more specific error code.
errors.ERR_POWER_PCT_NOT_SUPPORTED: The requested power percentage is not supported by this miner or cooling type.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE_INVALID: The miner returned an invalid diagnostic-log response.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_INVALID: The diagnostic-log size is invalid or exceeds the 64 MiB safety limit.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The miner connection ended before the complete diagnostic-log archive was received.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: The API v2 diagnostic-log download timed out.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_CONNECTION: The API v2 diagnostic-log download connection failed or was reset.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_CONFIG_INVALID: The network parameter must explicitly select DHCP or provide a static IPv4 configuration.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_ADDRESS_INVALID: The static IP, netmask, gateway or DNS address is not a valid IPv4 address.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The API v2 network-setting connection failed after transmission; the miner may already be rebooting with the new address, so do not retry automatically.
errors.ERR_HOSTNAME_INVALID: The hostname must be 1-63 characters and contain only letters, digits and internal hyphens.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_PAYLOAD_INVALID: The firmware parameter must be an object containing serializable firmware metadata and data.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_FILENAME_INVALID: The firmware filename must be a non-empty basename without directory components.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_ENCODING_INVALID: The firmware encoding must be canonical Base64.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_SIZE_INVALID: The firmware image is empty or exceeds the configured size limit.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_SHA256_INVALID: A 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest is required.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_SHA256_MISMATCH: The downloaded firmware image does not match the required SHA-256 digest.
errors.ERR_INVALID_FIRMWARE: The firmware image does not contain a payload matching the miner control-board platform.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_READY_INVALID: The miner did not enter the firmware-upload ready state.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_UPDATE_FAILED: The miner rejected or failed the firmware update.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_UPDATE_TIMEOUT: The firmware update request timed out before the image was transmitted.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_UPDATE_CONNECTION: The firmware update connection failed before the image was transmitted.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The firmware image was transmitted but the final result could not be confirmed. Do not retry; verify the miner version after it reconnects.
